features: Motion Detection 2.0: deep learning-based human/vehicle classification, enabled by default for all analog channels
Facial detection and capture: face picture detection, face picture search
Motion detection 2.0 and perimeter protection cannot be enabled at the same time
Full channel recording at up to 1080p resolution
notes: IP video input: 2-ch by default (up to 18-ch); with enhanced IP mode on, 8-ch (up to 24-ch), each up to 4 Mbps.
Datasheet notes that enhanced IP mode may conflict with smart events or other functions.
Datasheet gives power consumption as ≤ 40 W without stating whether an HDD is installed.
